items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Harry James himself. I met everybody, Benny. You know, I met everybody.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's where Basie heard Freddy Green.

That's where John Hammond heard Freddy Green. John Hammond lived in the area on Sullivan Street and he used to bring his family to dinner. We worked seven days a week from seven to four, seven days a week.

Then what I wanted to say was that John was the one that introduced listening audience/concertwise. Prior to this it didn't happen, but he would come in and we had a small dance floor, and he'd have the waiters push the chairs out on the floor so he could sit and he would bring Benny Goodman, Harry James, the Count, Mary Lou Williams, Teddy Wilson.
